name: multi_root_smallest_positive
derivation: cf = [-100,000, +250,000, -156,000] agorot: two sign changes => up to two IRR roots.
x = (250 +/- 10)/200 = 1.3 or 1.2  =>  roots r = 0.3 and r = 0.2. BOTH are genuine IRRs.
Root policy: smallest positive root in (-0.99, 10) => expected irr = 0.2.
Simple payback (first-crossing convention): cumulative -100,000 then +150,000; recovery
inside period 1: 100,000/250,000 = 0.4 periods. The later dip to -6,000 at t=2 is ignored
by the documented first-crossing rule — this fixture pins that convention.
